nav.forms_tooltip: Build forms your agent shows in the chat

forms.title: Forms
forms.empty: No forms yet. Create one to get started.
forms.subtitle: Description
forms.subtitle_placeholder: e.g. Tell us about your company and we'll get in touch.
forms.subtitle_hint: Shown to the visitor under the form title.
forms.maps_to_help_1: Tags this field as a standard contact attribute — Name, Email, Phone, and so on. The value the visitor enters is then recognised as that piece of contact info, not just an anonymous answer.
forms.maps_to_help_2: Mapped fields fill the lead’s details — powering the leads list, duplicate detection, and CSV export. Leave it as “—” to capture the answer without tagging it.
forms.options_placeholder: One option per line. Use value{'|'}label for separate values.
forms.name_required: Please give the form a name.
forms.description_placeholder: e.g. Show when the visitor wants a quote, a demo, or to be contacted
forms.description_hint: The agent uses this to decide when to render this form in a conversation.
